gemm_timing: exact selected OS tile events, one input tile buffer per core, work-conserving FIFO fluid DMA shared by DRAM/path and private direction SRAM endpoints
mapping: unchanged original CapacityAware mapper and original hardware objective; no timing-driven remapping or double buffering
d2d_bandwidth_status: unchanged user design assumption; per-edge/per-direction caliber unverified, test 1000/2000/4000 separately
attention_timing: unchanged arithmetic and affine context dependence; direction SRAM term with explicit units; no dynamic tile event replacement in decode
vector_timing: Unchanged analytic vector streaming; six representative vector reference discrepancies are quantified in timeline-provider-validation.json. Vector throughput256 remains an assumption; not equated with published FP32 tensor throughput.
legacy_sram_bytes_per_ns_scope: HardwareConfig scalar4000 retained only for original mapper identity and unchanged vector provider; GEMM and attention service use direction400/270 from this profile. It is not asserted as physical SRAM bandwidth.

source.scope: Dojo node SRAM and inter-die interface proxy parameters; hypothetical 256-core WSC, not physical D1 reproduction. 1.02TF/core@1GHz remains WSC-LLM-inspired BF16=FP16 assumption.

network: Must pair with separately versioned corrected streaming native backend; existing whole-chunk store-forward result is a reference scenario, not a calibrated cut-through prediction.
publication_scope: Conditional architecture simulation with declared assumptions and reference validation; not measured physical WSC latency. All WSC scheduling methods must use one common version.
